items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Jack Cook and Symphony Sid. They were four partners in that label... [INTERVIEWEE] Well, you name me four guys that was involved with jazz all their lives. The young one was Morris Levy... Symphony Sid and the other guy...

ctx.x: Jack Cook, right. Ahh, so when he was in your band, he wasn't drafted? He left with Chino Pozo to - with Jack Cook?
and then he come back to the band.
